After growth stagnating during FY21-24 due to restructuring, ELLEN has nearly tripled its capacity during FY24-26. Further, it has plans to expand capacity by ~50% during FY26-28E. ELLEN’s growth outlook is further supported by rising MSME demand, lower energy costs and ongoing capacity expansion. The INR4.8bn BHEL contract further strengthens revenue visibility, although relatively lower project engineering margins may moderate overall profitability. At CMP, the stock trades at 17x FY29E EPS and 14x FY29E EV/EBITDA. We expect revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR of 41%/41%/32% over FY26–FY29E, driven by policy initiatives supporting industrial gas demand and planned capacity additions. We initiate coverage with a BUY rating. Market share to rise with MSME demand: With revenue of INR3.4bn in FY26, ELLEN is one-eighth the size of its competitor Linde (LINDEINDIA IN). As larger players are less inclined to pursue smaller projects amid rising MSME demand for industrial gases, we expect ELLEN to gain market share going ahead. Ongoing expansion to increase capacity by ~50% during FY26-28E: ELLEN has announced plans to increase its installed from 1,613tpd in FY26 to 2,433tpd by FY28E, following a scale-up post restructuring.
